interface.shortDescription: 可审计四柱计算与传统文化解读
interface.longDescription: 以离线确定性引擎处理冻结历法、历史时区、边界候选和流派差异，再按固定来源规则生成可复核的传统文化解读。计算已做工程验证但尚未独立认证；传统人生预测未获实证验证，也不用于医疗、法律、金融或其他高风险决策。
capabilities: Deterministic Four Pillars chart calculation with auditable calendar, timezone, and rule metadata.
Explicit comparison of Zi-hour, civil-time, and approximate local apparent-solar-time variants.
Source-constrained traditional cultural interpretation in professional and plain-language formats.
Uncertainty candidates, provenance, validation limits, and safety boundaries disclosed in reports.
